$comment: Spec-kit compatibility contract for Uroboros. Human-readable version: references/spec-kit-compat.md. Read by the run skill's compatibility check (skills/run/SKILL.md) and by /uroboros:compat (skills/compat/SKILL.md). Update it, the snapshot, and CHANGELOG.md together whenever a new spec-kit line is adopted.

policy.snapshot: one snapshot per spec-kit major.minor line, taken from the x.y.0 tag with a pristine `specify init` (see the snapshot's NOTICE.md); patches within a line are never snapshotted; older lines keep their snapshot (snapshot.lines) so /uroboros:compat diffs a project on an older reviewed line against its own line
policy.minor: a new minor gets a new snapshot, a row in the per-line review, and becomes the baseline
policy.major: a new major is never assumed compatible: the run skill asks before proceeding on such a project until the contract has been re-verified

baseline.method: pristine installs of the v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.1.2 tags (Claude integration, skills mode, script ps, git extension) diffed file by file; every touchpoint below checked on 1.1.0; 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 change no skill, template or extensions.yml

version_sources.meaning: version of the spec-kit that installed the Claude skills the run invokes (refreshed by `specify integration upgrade claude`)
version recorded when the project was initialized

install_manifest.meaning: SHA-256 of every file spec-kit installed for the Claude integration, keyed by path (e.g. .claude/skills/speckit-specify/SKILL.md); a different hash on disk means the file was modified after install (formatter, hand edit) — spec-kit's own `integration upgrade` refuses to overwrite such files without --force. Extension skills (speckit-git-feature) are not listed

cli.pristine_install: uvx --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v<version> specify init <dir> --integration claude --script ps --ignore-agent-tools --extension git (before 0.16.0: no --extension flag, run `specify extension add git` inside the project afterwards; --non-interactive exists from 1.0.0)

audited.speckit-implement: never invoked (the uroboros-implementer subagent replaces it), so its absence does not stop a run; snapshotted and diffed by /uroboros:compat because its checklist handling is touchpoint 12

optional.speckit-git-feature: feature-branch creation (git extension); absent => the run continues branchless
optional.speckit-converge: convergence gate at the close of implement (spec-kit >= 0.11.2); absent => the gate is skipped and noted in loop-state.md

used_by: skills/run/SKILL.md (Phase -1 resume, step B artifact paths)

hook_directives.note: since 0.12.x (before the plugin existed) the skills tell the agent to actually invoke a mandatory hook and wait; `before_specify` -> `speckit.git.feature` has been mandatory (optional: false) in every version from 0.12.10 to 1.1.0. Since 1.1.0 a skill that cannot parse extensions.yml tells the user the parser error and that no hooks were checked, mandatory ones included, then continues (before 1.1.0 it skipped hook checking silently). Uroboros is the hook executor (hard rule 2)
hook_directives.events_not_used: constitution, checklist and taskstoissues hooks (skills the loop never invokes) and implement hooks (the uroboros-implementer subagent replaces speckit-implement, so before/after_implement never fire)

policy.speckit.git.feature: skip when Phase 0.5 already created the branch
policy.optional: decline silently, record under DECLINED HOOKS, list in the Loop Report
policy.other_mandatory: invoke the named skill yourself and continue
policy.unreadable: extensions.yml exists but cannot be parsed: the compatibility check asks once (stop to fix the file / continue without hooks; --auto continues and records A<n>), records HOOKS: unreadable in loop-state.md, and the Loop Report repeats it

artifact_conventions.convergence_section: ## Phase N: Convergence (append-only, tasks T{max+1}... with source-refs)
artifact_conventions.checklists_since_1_0: checklists/requirements.md is maintained by specify/clarify; implement treats checklist markers as a read-only gate (changed in 1.0.0)

snapshot.note: Projects initialized with `--script sh` differ from the snapshot only in the `.specify/scripts/...` paths inside the skills; treat those hunks as expected. 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 write the git-extension skills with CRLF on Windows; the snapshot stores them normalized to LF.

history.note: built against (0.12.10 and 0.12.11 shipped that day)
contract introduced; every line from 0.12.10 reviewed by diff; full run
1.1 line adopted; 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 reviewed by diff; unreadable extensions.yml handled; older lines keep their snapshot; full run on 1.1.0 (uroboros-testbed scenario v5)
